description: Tariq Glass Industries Limited manufactures glass tableware and float glass in Pakistan. It produces tableware on single and double gob press machines as well as H-28 press-and-blow and stretch machines at a capacity of almost 300 tons per day, and its Toyo Nasic, Omroc and Nova brands are exported. In 2013 the company launched Tariq Float Glass, a plant with a capacity of 550 tons per day producing clear float glass from 2 mm to 13 mm, tinted and reflective glass through an online CVD coating machine, sandblasted glass and aluminium-coated mirrors.

products.name: Tableware
products.summary: Glass tableware — water sets, tumblers, ice cream and tea sets, jugs, cake sets, ashtrays, stemware, fruit sets, plates and bowls, and mugs — sold under the Toyo Nasic, Omroc and Nova brands.

products.name: Float glass
products.summary: Clear float glass from 2 mm to 13 mm, plus tinted and reflective glass, produced at the Tariq Float Glass plant with a capacity of 550 tons per day.

products.name: Bottles and jars

products.name: Decorated and processed glass
products.summary: Sandblasted glass and aluminium-coated mirrors, and decorated ware finished on the company's Tecno 5 decorating machines.
